draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.12, the 113th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 8th of 19 at RB. He lasted until pick 257, well after his grade rank (113th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Jordan Howard. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 858 rushing yards in 2020, 10th of 19 RBs in his class with stats.
